name: distill-trace
description: Temporary per-chat command history with Distill severity, policy decisions, and output.

distill.binaryPath.description: Optional absolute path to a custom Distill CLI. Empty automatically installs the verified CLI bundled with this extension; no separate installation is required.

distill.codexHome.description: Optional Codex home for chat titles. Reads only session_index.jsonl metadata; defaults to CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

distill.llm.enabled.description: Enable advisory model routing for unresolved commands and start the optional local service. Disabled uses static analysis only, including when a local classifier is configured.

distill.llm.provider.description: Request format and endpoint preset. Uses exactly the selected model; never falls back to a cloud or more expensive model.

distill.llm.endpoint.description: Provider endpoint override. Gemini uses an API base URL (default https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta); other providers use a full request URL. Empty uses the provider preset. HTTPS or loopback HTTP only.

distill.llm.model.markdownDescription: Select a model for the configured provider. For another model or local served alias, choose **Custom model…** and set `#distill.llm.customModel#`. The **Distill: Configure LLM Router** command opens the provider-specific form and secure API key entry.

enumDescriptions: Use the selected provider’s default variable.
OpenAI key.
Google Gemini key.
Anthropic Claude key.
Keyless local or compatible server.
Use Custom API Key Env below.
distill.llm.apiKeyEnv.description: Select the key variable. Enter the actual key in Distill: Configure LLM Router; keys use encrypted SecretStorage.

distill.llm.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum generated tokens per model request. No retries or fallback model requests are made.

distill.llm.reasoningEffort.description: Explicit reasoning_effort for OpenAI-compatible APIs, including local servers. Applied unchanged to every model; support depends on the endpoint and model. Provider default omits the parameter. Gemini and Claude require Provider default. Use the same explicit effort for latency comparisons; unsupported values return an error without retries or model fallback.

distill.llm.deadlineMs.description: Legacy synchronous model budget. Background advice uses Background Deadline Ms; the hook waits at most 40 ms for a local queue acknowledgement.

distill.llm.sendScriptContents.description: Allow up to 8 KiB of inspected script excerpts in model requests. Command and structured analysis are sent when routing is enabled; script contents require this separate opt-in.

distill.llm.customApiKeyEnv.description: Variable name used when API Key Env is custom. This is a name, never the API key.

distill.llm.backgroundDeadlineMs.description: Timeout for background model advice. The hook returns its static verdict without waiting for model completion.

distill.llm.customModel.markdownDescription: Exact model ID or local served-model alias. Used when `#distill.llm.model#` is **Custom model…**. Enter API keys through **Distill: Configure LLM Router**.

distill.llm.reviewFormat.description: Severity replies use one lowercase label per command, separated by semicolons. Effects preserves legacy JSON advice. Neither grants execution approval.

distill.llm.batchWindowMs.description: Fixed wait from the first pending severity review to group overlapping requests. 0 sends immediately. Batching reduces API calls but adds queue delay; measure with your provider.
